pick.headline: Czechoslovakia votes in its first free elections since 1946
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of June 11, 1990, carried Prague CTK on television projections: Civic Forum and Public Against Violence winning about 48 percent for the Federal Assembly, the Communists about 13 percent.
